title: Slack bot posts the same reply two or three times for one message
symptoms: Duplicate replies to a single user message
cause: Slack treats any event request not answered with a 2xx within three seconds as failed and retries up to three times. A handler that does slow work before responding gets each retry and acts again.
fix: Return 200 at once and do the work afterwards, dedupe on event_id, and ignore or answer retries. Send x-slack-no-retry: 1 on a non-200 if you never want a redelivery.
affected: Slack Events API over HTTP, all versions as of 2026-10
